whyUs.title: Tours with People from the Morro
whyUs.subtitle: Straightforward walking tours focused on genuine community life and mutual respect.
whyUs.pillar1Desc: Your guide grew up here, lives here, and knows every street.
whyUs.pillar2Desc: Calm walking pace respecting daily life and neighborhood residents.
whyUs.pillar3Desc: Stops along the way support corner stores, snack stands, and local artisans.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do booking and payment work?
faq.a1: Choose your tour, date, and group size. We confirm the meeting point on WhatsApp and payment is made on the day of the tour.
faq.q2: Are tours in the favelas safe?
faq.a2: Yes. Every tour is led by residents born and raised in the community who know every street and have longstanding ties with their neighbors.
faq.q3: Can I take multiple tours on the same day?
faq.a3: Yes. Visitors often do Rocinha in the morning followed by the Vidigal trail or City Tour in the afternoon. Message us on WhatsApp to coordinate.
faq.a4: We host and guide tours in Portuguese and English.

miolo.title: The Route: Alleys and Lookouts
miolo.description: Walk along the main paths, observe popular construction methods, and view Rio from the highest points of the community.
miolo.card1Desc: Practical building methods developed by residents over decades.
miolo.card2Desc: Open views of São Conrado, Pedra da Gávea, and the beach.
miolo.card3Desc: Conversations with local shopkeepers, residents, and artists.

arte.title: Art, Music & Local Food
arte.description: Street murals, capoeira, and traditional snacks along the way.
arte.pin1Desc: Walls painted by local artists telling community stories.
arte.pin2Desc: Traditional rhythms part of daily life in the morro.
arte.pin3Desc: Stop to try traditional snacks at neighborhood spots.
